C1 completed.notes: English 'complete exactly when no operation blocks it, and then the timer tracks nothing' matches C1Completed (count == 0 gives Completed, Untracked) and Evaluate's first branch.

U1 unresolved-owners.notes: Under count != 0, UnresolvedOwners exactly when OnlyOwners (every blocker listed, at least one, each a suspect terminal-receipt persistence write of a session), via AllOwnersSpec; a truncated list fails AllOwners at Nil and waits.

W1 unlisted.notes: count != 0 with no listed blockers gives Step(Waiting, tracked); the shell cannot produce this input (count > 0 always lists one), so the law is vacuous at the seam, not wrong.

O1 oldest-tracked.notes: Oldest matches OldestOf; Progress equals LatestOf over the session's listed blockers (ProgressSpec, LatestSpec), which under A2 carry the latest progress of the session's omitted blockers (runtime-registry.ts omitted-progress carry).

R1 timer-reset.notes: since == (if Unchanged(tracked, o, p) then tracked.since else Signal(p, o.admitted, now)) with p O1's judged progress, matching the English and Evaluate via SameSpec. A backward move to an older judged progress also resets the timer; that pre-existing behaviour is tracked as #2685 and needs its own law revision.

T1 stalled.notes: Stalled(oldest id, Age(now, since)) when age >= limit, else Waiting, with since from the post-step tracked value and Age clamped at zero; matches the English and Evaluate.
